A ticket assignee must be an active CONTRIBUTOR or MANAGER membership in the same project. Priority P0 is highest and P4 lowest; ticket lists sort by priority ascending then id only when priority_sort is true, otherwise by id.

Every successful project, membership, or ticket write atomically appends an immutable audit event with actor_account_id, project_id, event_type PROJECT_CREATED, PROJECT_UPDATED, PROJECT_DELETED, MEMBERSHIP_CREATED, MEMBERSHIP_UPDATED, MEMBERSHIP_REMOVED, TICKET_CREATED, or TICKET_UPDATED, subject type and id, and a redacted changed_fields list of 1..20 field names. Audit rows are never edited or deleted.
